segments.speaker: Jenna
segments.text: Hey Marco, quick one on Cedar Ridge. I'm cleaning up the CRM before forecast call and the expansion line looks, uh, a little half-built.

segments.text: Yeah, I saw that. Is this the 18 seat add-on for the analytics module or the services thing?

segments.text: The 18 seats. They asked for them in the admin email on Tuesday, $92 per seat monthly if we keep them on the same tier. I just need to know if deal desk wants a fresh order form.

segments.speaker: Marco
segments.text: If it's co-termed, yeah, fresh order form. Billing tool won't pick it up from the seat request alone. Did you check the account flags?

segments.speaker: Jenna
segments.text: That's the thing. For their workspace, 64 users are still enabled in the product, the billing tool shows service through 7/31, and I don't see a customer thread after Kim's May 16 QBR note.

segments.speaker: Marco
segments.text: Okay. Then don't touch the seat count yet. Put it in the CRM as pending ops review, zero it out for this week's commit.

segments.speaker: Jenna
segments.text: Got it. I'll move the close date to 8/9 and add the note. Do you want me to ping finance or wait until you look?

segments.speaker: Marco
segments.text: Ping finance with the account ID and invoice number 41872. Just ask whether August usage is on hold or queued, nothing fancy.

segments.speaker: Jenna
segments.text: Yeah, makes sense. And for the pricing sheet, I'm using standard month-to-month add-on pricing, no discount, right?

segments.speaker: Marco
segments.text: Right. If it comes back clean, we can send the simple form. If not, we'll package it with whatever ops tells us.
